ArticleContent.description: The content of an article. All text in it is untrusted

body.description: The plain text with line feeds as line endings; empty when the article has none

delSp.description: Whether the flowed text was sent with DelSp=yes

flowed.description: Whether the text is format=flowed (RFC 3676) and has to be unwrapped

truncated.description: Whether a limit stopped the processing, so that the text is not all of the article

ArticleDraft.description: What the owner wrote. The article is built from it by the backend

body.description: The text, with the quoted lines of a reply

includeSignature.description: Whether the signature of the identity is appended; true when absent

messageId.description: Null at the first attempt; afterwards the messageId of the failed attempt, so that trying again cannot create a second article

parentId.description: The article that is answered; null for a new discussion

message.description: Names the cause; never contains credentials

id.description: The stored server whose password is used when the password is empty or absent

postingAllowed.description: Whether the server that takes the posts offers posting: the separate posting server when one is set. null when the test of that server failed

postingServerFailure.description: Why the test of the separate posting server failed. null when there is none, when it worked, or when the test of the server itself failed already

articlesPerDay.description: How many articles the group gets per day, counted over the last 7 to 14 days; approximate. null while it is not known

description.description: null when the server gave none; to be shown as text only

name.description: Comes from the server; to be shown as text only

error.description: Why the last refresh failed; null when it succeeded

groupsReceived.description: The groups received by the running refresh, or by the last one

refreshedAt.description: The time of the last successful refresh in milliseconds; null when none has succeeded

activityKnown.description: Whether the activity of at least one group of the server is known. It is not in the first day after the group list was first loaded

total.description: The number of groups over all pages

IgnoreRule.description: An author or a thread the owner ignores

createdAt.description: When the rule was created, in UTC milliseconds

label.description: The display name of the author or the subject of the thread; untrusted text

articleId.description: An article by the author, or any article or stub of the thread

kind.description: What is ignored: the author of the article, or the thread of the article

until.description: The time before which the group is shown, in UTC milliseconds: the end of the chosen day in the time zone of the browser, which is the start of the next day

oldestDate.description: The date of the oldest article of the server, in UTC milliseconds, when there is no range; otherwise null

range.description: The range that ends the view; null when the chosen day is before the oldest article of the server

rememberMe.description: Whether the browser keeps the session cookie after it is closed; false if absent

OmittedPart.description: A part of an article that is not displayed and not stored

name.description: The file name the article gives; untrusted text

rootId.description: The root of the thread the article is in

PostingIdentity.description: The name, email address and signature the owner posts with on a server. All fields are null until an identity is set

signature.description: Appended to a post after a line "-- "; null when there is none

passwordStored.description: Whether a password of its own is stored; the password itself is never returned

sameLogin.description: Whether the login of the server is used

username.description: null unless the authentication is USER_PASS

PostingServerRequest.description: A separate server that takes the posts

authMethod.description: Needed without sameLogin. USER_PASS needs the TLS mode IMPLICIT

host.description: Host name or IP address, 1 to 253 characters

password.description: 1 to 255 characters. Needed for USER_PASS when no password is stored; empty or absent keeps the stored one

sameLogin.description: Whether the login of the server is used. Then the three fields below are ignored

Range.description: A range of article numbers whose overviews are stored

atNewest.description: Whether the range is the newest of the group

atOldest.description: Whether nothing older can be loaded

connectionTest.description: The server is saved also when this test failed

credentialsInvalid.description: The server rejected the stored credentials, or the stored password can no longer be read; the owner has to enter them again

passwordStored.description: Whether a password is stored; the password itself is never returned

postingServer.description: The separate server for posting; null when posts go to the server itself

username.description: null unless the authentication is USER_PASS

authMethod.description: USER_PASS needs the TLS mode IMPLICIT

host.description: Host name or IP address, 1 to 253 characters

name.description: 1 to 64 characters; surrounding whitespace is removed

password.description: 1 to 255 characters. Needed for USER_PASS when no password is stored; empty or absent keeps the stored one

postingServer.description: null or absent when posts go to the server itself

cacheLimitEnabled.description: Whether the cache size limit applies (ADR 0034)

cacheLimitUnreachable.description: Whether the database is above the limit although no cached content is left to delete

cacheUsedBytes.description: The space the database uses now, in bytes

groupListIntervalHours.description: How often the group list is fetched, in hours; 1 to 168

initialDepth.description: How many overviews a first synchronization fetches at most; 50 to 10000

maxCacheSizeGb.description: The cache size limit in gigabytes; 1 to 1000. It is kept while the limit is off

syncIntervalMinutes.description: How often all subscribed groups are synchronized, in minutes; 5 to 1440

username.description: 1 to 64 characters; surrounding whitespace is removed

description.description: null when the server gave none; to be shown as text only

name.description: Comes from the server; to be shown as text only

removed.description: Whether the server no longer lists the group

unreadCount.description: Articles of the group that are not read yet

error.description: Why the last synchronization failed; null when it succeeded

lastSyncedAt.description: The time of the last successful synchronization in milliseconds; null when none has succeeded

Thread.description: A thread with its articles in display order

ignoreRuleIds.description: The ignore rules that ignore the thread; removing them all stops ignoring it. Empty when the thread is not ignored

ignored.description: Whether the owner ignores the thread

rootId.description: The current root of the thread

ThreadArticle.description: An article or stub of a thread. All text in it is untrusted

authorKey.description: The key the author icon is derived from; null for a stub

date.description: UTC milliseconds; null when the date cannot be read

depth.description: How many articles lie between it and the thread root; 0 for the root

ignoredAuthor.description: Whether the owner ignores the author of the article

isStub.description: Whether the article is only referenced and not stored

otherGroup.description: The name of a group the article is located in, when it is not located in this group

parentId.description: The article it answers; null for the thread root

sent.description: Whether the owner posted the article from this group and the server does not list it there yet

ThreadCard.description: A thread of a group as its card shows it. All text in it is untrusted

authorKey.description: The key the author icon is derived from

cardArticleId.description: The article whose subject, author and date stand for the thread

date.description: The date of the card article in UTC milliseconds; null when it cannot be read

excerpt.description: The beginning of the text of the card article; null when its content is not cached or it has no text of its own

latestActivity.description: The newest date among those articles in UTC milliseconds; null when none has a date

messageCount.description: The articles of the thread located in the group

rootId.description: The topmost article of the thread, which can be a stub

unreadCount.description: How many of those articles are not read

ThreadPage.description: One page of the thread cards of a group

highWatermarkReached.description: Whether nothing newer than the range can be loaded

lowWatermarkReached.description: Whether nothing older than the range can be loaded

nextCursor.description: To be sent as cursor for the next page; null on the last page

rangeId.description: The synchronized range the list shows: the newest one of the group, or the one of the jump in a date view; null when the group has none yet

410.description: The server no longer has the article

502.description: The content could not be fetched

429.description: Too many failed logins; the Retry-After header has the waiting time in seconds

400.description: The current password is wrong or the new one breaks a rule

put.summary: Changes the password and ends all sessions, including the current one

200.description: No account exists yet; setup is available

400.description: Username or password breaks a rule

post.summary: Creates the account and logs in

201.description: The server accepted the article; it is stored

400.description: The subject or the text is missing, the article is larger than 64 KB, or the messageId is not one of Wardroom

404.description: No group or parent has this ID, or the group is not subscribed

409.description: No posting identity is set, the group does not allow posting, the author of the parent asked for replies by email, or the parent has no content

502.description: The server did not take the article. The type is POSTING_NOT_ALLOWED, AUTH_REQUIRED, POSTING_FAILED or UNREACHABLE, the detail is the message of the server, and messageId is what to try again with

post.summary: Posts a new discussion or a reply from a subscribed group

200.description: The range that ends the view

409.description: The group is not subscribed, not synchronized yet or being synchronized, or the credentials of the server are invalid

502.description: The server could not be asked, or the dates of the group could not be read

204.description: All articles of the group are read

post.summary: Marks all articles of the group as read

200.description: The range as it is stored now

404.description: No group has this ID, or the group has no such range

409.description: The group is not subscribed or being synchronized, or the credentials of the server are invalid

502.description: The server could not be asked

post.summary: Loads older overviews below a range

204.description: The group is not subscribed; it may not have been before

delete.summary: Unsubscribes from the group and deletes its cached articles and their read state

204.description: The group is subscribed; it may have been so before

409.description: The server no longer lists the group

202.description: A synchronization was started or is running already

409.description: The group is not subscribed, or the credentials of the server are invalid
